1: # Tasks: Enhance Milestone Markers
2: 
3: ## Implementation Checklist
4: 
5: ### Phase 1: Foundation
6: - [ ] Remove milestone year filter (show all years on x-axis)
7:   - **File**: `src/components/visualizations/TimelineArea.tsx`
8:   - **Change**: Remove `.filter((year) => year % 2 === 1)` from yearTicks
9:   - **Validation**: X-axis shows every year from 2009-2026
10: 
11: - [ ] Add category filtering state management
12:   - **File**: `src/components/visualizations/TimelineArea.tsx`
13:   - **Change**: Add `useState<string | null>(null)` for highlightedCategory
14:   - **Validation**: State exists and can be updated
15: 
16: ### Phase 2: Category Legend Enhancement
17: - [ ] Convert category legend to interactive buttons
18:   - **File**: `src/components/visualizations/TimelineArea.tsx`
19:   - **Change**: Convert `<div>` to `<button>` with onClick handler
20:   - **Validation**: Legend items are clickable
21: 
22: - [ ] Add visual feedback for selected/unselected categories
23:   - **File**: `src/components/visualizations/TimelineArea.tsx`
24:   - **Change**: Apply conditional classNames (highlight, dim)
25:   - **Validation**: Selected category shows background, others dim
26: 
27: - [ ] Apply opacity changes to Area components
28:   - **File**: `src/components/visualizations/TimelineArea.tsx`
29:   - **Change**: Add fillOpacity/strokeOpacity based on highlightedCategory
30:   - **Validation**: Click legend → corresponding area highlights, others dim
31: 
32: ### Phase 3: Chronological Category Stacking
33: - [ ] Compute category first-appearance order
34:   - **File**: `src/components/visualizations/TimelineArea.tsx`
35:   - **Change**: Add useMemo to sort categories by first non-zero data point
36:   - **Validation**: Categories render bottom-to-top by first appearance date
37: 
38: - [ ] Update Area rendering to use sorted categories
39:   - **File**: `src/components/visualizations/TimelineArea.tsx`
40:   - **Change**: Replace `[...categories].reverse()` with `sortedCategories`
41:   - **Validation**: Earlier skills at bottom, newer skills on top
42: 
43: ### Phase 4: Milestone Marker Investigation
44: - [ ] Research Recharts v3.6.0 capabilities for custom markers
45:   - **Actions**: Check docs, test Customized component, test ReferenceLine custom labels
46:   - **Outcome**: Document which approaches work/don't work
47: 
48: - [ ] Evaluate alternative approaches (SVG overlay, Scatter, etc.)
49:   - **Actions**: Prototype each approach, measure alignment accuracy
50:   - **Outcome**: Select most reliable approach
51: 
52: ### Phase 5: Milestone Marker Implementation
53: 
54: **Dependency**: Phase 4 complete with approach selected
55: 
56: - [ ] Create MilestoneMarker SVG component
57:   - **File**: `src/components/visualizations/TimelineArea.tsx`
58:   - **Component**: Renders dot-line-hexagon with hover states
59:   - **Validation**: Component renders correctly in isolation
60: 
61: - [ ] Integrate markers into chart (approach-dependent)
62:   - **File**: `src/components/visualizations/TimelineArea.tsx`
63:   - **Implementation**: Use selected approach from Phase 4
64:   - **Validation**: Markers appear on chart at milestone years
65: 
66: - [ ] Verify marker positioning accuracy
67:   - **Actions**: Visual inspection, screenshot comparison
68:   - **Validation**: Markers align exactly with x-axis ticks
69: 
70: - [ ] Connect hover/click event handlers
71:   - **File**: `src/components/visualizations/TimelineArea.tsx`
72:   - **Change**: Wire setHoveredMilestone and setSelectedMilestone
73:   - **Validation**: Hover shows tooltip, click opens modal
74: 
75: ### Phase 6: Tooltip Repositioning
76: - [ ] Move milestone tooltip above chart
77:   - **File**: `src/components/visualizations/TimelineArea.tsx`
78:   - **Change**: Position tooltip at top of chart container (not in separate section)
79:   - **Validation**: Tooltip appears near hovered marker
80: 
81: - [ ] Remove old milestone badges section
82:   - **File**: `src/components/visualizations/TimelineArea.tsx`
83:   - **Change**: Delete "★ Career Milestones" section with year badges
84:   - **Validation**: Badges removed, chart-integrated markers remain
85: 
86: ### Phase 7: Visual Polish
87: - [ ] Add smooth transitions to marker hover states
88:   - **File**: `src/components/visualizations/TimelineArea.tsx`
89:   - **Change**: CSS transitions (0.15s ease-out) on radius, stroke-width, fill
90:   - **Validation**: Hover transitions are smooth
91: 
92: - [ ] Ensure marker colors match theme
93:   - **File**: `src/components/visualizations/TimelineArea.tsx`
94:   - **Change**: Use `var(--color-engineering)` for consistency
95:   - **Validation**: Colors match rest of timeline
96: 
97: - [ ] Optimize chart bottom margin for marker visibility
98:   - **File**: `src/components/visualizations/TimelineArea.tsx`
99:   - **Change**: Increase bottom margin if needed (20px → 40px)
100:   - **Validation**: Hexagons not cut off by chart bounds
101: 
102: ### Phase 8: Accessibility & Testing
103: - [ ] Add keyboard navigation to markers
104:   - **File**: `src/components/visualizations/TimelineArea.tsx`
105:   - **Change**: Add tabindex, focus handlers, keyboard event listeners
106:   - **Validation**: Tab to markers, Enter/Space activates
107: 
108: - [ ] Update screen reader description
109:   - **File**: `src/components/visualizations/TimelineArea.tsx`
110:   - **Change**: Update sr-only text to mention integrated markers
111:   - **Validation**: Screen reader announces marker interactivity
112: 
113: - [ ] Add/update tests for milestone interactions
114:   - **File**: `src/components/visualizations/TimelineArea.test.tsx`
115:   - **Tests**: Hover, click, tooltip display, modal open
116:   - **Validation**: All tests pass
117: 
118: - [ ] Run full test suite
119:   - **Command**: `npm test`
120:   - **Validation**: No regressions, 60/60 tests pass
121: 
122: - [ ] Manual testing across viewports
123:   - **Actions**: Test on 375px, 768px, 1024px, 1920px
124:   - **Validation**: Markers render correctly at all sizes
125: 
126: ### Phase 9: Validation
127: - [ ] Validate OpenSpec compliance
128:   - **Command**: `openspec validate enhance-milestone-markers --strict --no-interactive`
129:   - **Validation**: All requirements met, no validation errors
130: 
131: - [ ] Lighthouse accessibility audit
132:   - **Target**: 90+ accessibility score maintained
133:   - **Validation**: No accessibility regressions
134: 
135: - [ ] Visual regression testing
136:   - **Actions**: Screenshot comparison before/after
137:   - **Validation**: Unintended visual changes identified
138: 
139: ## Notes
140: 
141: - **Parallel work**: Phases 2-3 (legend enhancement, stacking) can proceed independently of Phase 4-5 (marker investigation/implementation)
142: - **Decision point**: Phase 4 outcome determines Phase 5 implementation details
143: - **Rollback option**: If marker integration proves unreliable, keep current hybrid approach as fallback
